text:
Maya: Heads up — PR #9817 (routing thin-client) is ready but gated on architecture sign-off. RFC link: https://redwood.infra/docs/rfcs/2024-20-routing-thin-client. Can arch please advise on safety and merge window? This touches fallback ordering and shard affinity.
jon: Thanks Maya. Assigning to @Liu for architecture eyes. Is there a short summary of SLO impact we can paste here?
Liu: I can take a look after stand in ~30m. Quick ask: what’s the intended canary plan and which routes/models are touched?
Maya: Canary plan is in the PR description but short version: 10% traffic for 2h -> 50% for 1h, automatic rollback on error rate spike >0.5%. Affects router fast-path only (all hosted models behind the fast-path). Fallback goes to v1 router.
Ben: FYI saw flaky e2e on staging earlier — pushed a fix to the branch, CI rerunning now.
Liu: Skimmed the RFC — one question about KV cache invalidation on failover. @Sara can you confirm cache TTLs and whether failover could cause stale responses? Also we need perf numbers for 512-token tails before we bless this.
Sara: Cache TTLs are unchanged; failover triggers a drop-and-repopulate, not silent reuse. Perf numbers (local p4d run): 95th latency delta ~ +6ms for 512 tokens, median unchanged. Paste: ```p95_before=82ms p95_after=88ms p50_before=23ms p50_after=24ms```
Maya: Those numbers look fine to me. Would prefer to merge in tonight’s release slot (22:00 PST) if arch signs off. If arch requests a safety guard we can add it as a quick follow-up.
Liu: One small nit: the fallback ordering could in rare cases send a request to the wrong tenant if the affinity guard isn’t checked first. Recommend adding a tenant-affinity guard in router (cheap check) and a unit test. After that, I’m happy to sign off.
Maya: OK — I’ll add the guard + unit test as a small commit to this branch and update the RFC note. Will push within 15m.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy successful for branch routing-thin-client (build 9817) at 1748301400.
jon: Great — @Liu ping me when you post LGTM so I can approve on GitHub.
Liu: LGTM — adding small test in follow-up commit, will mark in PR thread when pushed.
Maya: Pushed commit adding affinity guard + test and updated RFC section: https://redwood.infra/docs/rfcs/2024-20-routing-thin-client#affinity-guard. All CI green. Ready to merge in release slot 22:00 PST.
Ben: Approved on GH. :thumbsup:
Maya: Merging at 22:05 then. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround.
